name: Bespoke Synth
description: Modular, live-coding-friendly synthesis environment that can host plugins.
about:
A software modular synthesizer built around live-patching. Wire together oscillators, sequencers, effects and Python scripts while the music plays, then host VST plugins inside the patch.

It runs as a standalone app, so it works well as a sketchpad or live instrument.
notes: Standalone application, not a plugin bundle. Windows uses the MSI; macOS copies the .app into ~/Applications.
